name: Deadwind Pass and Karazhan
shortDescription: Deadwind Pass and Karazhan, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these TBC-version Deadwind Pass: slate ravines, dead black trees, cold fog, a narrow road and the tall dark gothic tower with restrained violet magic. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
